description: Contract — /session-save keeps one continuity document per topic in the host-neutral project continuity directory (`<project>/.itd-memory/continuity/<topic>.md`: next action, state, decisions, checks, blockers), rewritten whole, and appends the history to `.itd-memory/HISTORY.md` (plan session 7). Phase-2 CONTRACT validation pins the documented guarantees against SKILL.md (drift guard); the behaviour of the hooks that read the documents is tested by tests/verify_continuity.py; live behaviour stays with battle runs.
